c74object.name: evi_cossin
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_cossin.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_cossin.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
A collection of cosine/sine functions and supporting code for oft used approximiations.

entry.name: quartParApproxFull ( )
entry.description:
This function offers different precisions of a famous cos/sin osc approximation. It is not intended for production but to extract the precision you need from the code.
In 1: type=input: modphase, Osc phase, must be wrapped 0..1
In 2: type=input: precision, Int 0..3. Type of precision. See source code for details.
Return 1: Cos, Cosine quadrature output
Return 2: Sin, Sine quadrature output
Return 3: Quart, Which quarter the approximation is currently in, int 0..3

entry.name: quartParOneApprox ( )
entry.description:
Highly optimised cosine quarter extracted from 'quartParApproxFull()', excellent for crossfading or panning applications
In 1: type=input: modphase, Osc phase, must be wrapped 0..1
Return 1: Cos, Cosine quadrature output
Return 2: Sin, Sine quadrature output

entry.name: quadratureOsc ( )
entry.description:
Not an approximation, just two full precision matched cycle() lookups in quadrature form
In 1: type=input: thisphase, Phase 0..1
In 2: type=input: thisspread, Should always be 0.75 for quadrature behaviour, but can be changed for other uses
Return 1: Real, Cosine (quadrature) output
Return 2: Imag, Sine (quadrature) output

entry.name: quadOsc ( )
entry.description:
Accurate and efficient quadrature oscillator approximation
In 1: type=input: frequency, in Hz
In 2: type=input: reset, Sample accurate phase reset
Return 1: Cos, Cosine quadrature output
Return 2: Sin, Sine quadrature output

entry.name: quadOscSync ( )
entry.description:
Accurate and efficient quadrature oscillator approximation with independent sync outputs
In 1: type=input: frequency, in Hz
In 2: type=input: reset, Sample accurate phase reset
Return 1: Cos, Cosine quadrature output
Return 2: Sin, Sine quadrature output
Return 3: Cos Sync, Sync output of cos quadrature oscillator
Return 4: Sin Sync, Sync output of sin quadrature oscillator

entry.name: tptSvfQuadOsc ( )
entry.description:
Quad osc from a tpt filter primed for audio rate FM, reset resets filter states
In 1: type=input: cutoff, in Hz
In 2: type=input: sync, Soft sync reset, use this not 'reset'
In 3: type=input: reset, Hard reset, use 'sync' instead for audio applications
In 4: type=param (optional): soft, default: 0.1, Softness of 'sync' reset 0..1
Return 1: Cos, Cosine quadrature output
Return 2: Sin, Sine quadrature output

entry.name: parabolApprox ( )
entry.description:
Very cheap parabolic approximation for LFOs etc, -1..1
In 1: type=input: phase, Sin phase 0..1
Return 1: Sine, In range -1..1

entry.name: parabolApprox01 ( )
entry.description:
Very cheap parabolic approximation for LFOs etc, 0..1
In 1: type=input: phase, Sin phase 0..1
Return 1: Sine, In range 0..1
